module_title: The Superlatives: Largest, Longest, and Highest
introduction: At this level, we cover the lakes and waterfalls that hold a 'Superlative' title (first, largest, highest). These are the most frequently repeated questions in exams.

core_concepts.title: Largest Brackish Water Lake
core_concepts.description: **Chilika Lake:** **Odisha**. It is the largest coastal lagoon in India and the second largest in the world. It hosts millions of migratory birds during winter.

core_concepts.title: Largest Freshwater Lake
core_concepts.description: **Wular Lake:** **Jammu and Kashmir**. It was formed as a result of tectonic activity and is fed by the **Jhelum River**.

core_concepts.title: Longest Lake in India
core_concepts.description: **Vembanad Lake:** **Kerala**. It is the longest lake in India. The famous 'Nehru Trophy Boat Race' (Vallam Kali) is conducted in a portion of this lake.

core_concepts.title: Highest Waterfalls in India
core_concepts.description:
1. **Kunchikal Falls:** **Karnataka**. It is the highest waterfall in India (455 meters), located on the **Varahi River**.
2. **Jog / Gersoppa Falls:** **Karnataka**. Also known as the Mahatma Gandhi Falls. It is located on the **Sharavati River** and is the highest 'plunge' waterfall in India.

important_entities.name: Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar
important_entities.significance: Unlike natural lakes, this is the largest man-made (artificial) lake in India, formed behind the Rihand Dam in Uttar Pradesh.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Older textbooks often list Jog Falls as the highest. However, as per current official data, **Kunchikal Falls** is the highest waterfall in India. Only select Jog Falls if Kunchikal is not in the options.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Jog Falls is on the 'Sharavati' river.

exam_strategy_tips: A guaranteed SSC CGL/CHSL question: 'Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?' Answer: Wular Lake (J&K).
